Settlements stay reversible for 42 epochs: a later audit that finds a settled answer was plagiarised or machine-spammed claws back the payout from the original recipient. A farmer's realised profit is thus provisional, and cashing out early does not protect it because the liability follows the identity through every checkpoint. That is 29 dollars per alias. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
